What is the ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis code for this patient?

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary:

Patient Information:
Patient Name: Anonymous
Medical Record Number: N/A
Gender: Female
Age: 29 years
Date of Admission: N/A
Date of Discharge: N/A

Reason for Admission:
The patient was admitted to the hospital for treatment of HIV infection.

Hospital Course:
During the admission, the patient was started on ART, and 186 SMS text messages were sent and received to remind her to take medication. The patient responded to only 28% of the text messages and did not respond to the remaining 72%. During feedback sessions, the patient claimed to have taken medication as per the instructions given and responded to all the text messages. Later, during an interview, the patient disclosed that she was not honest during the feedback sessions as she was depressed about unwanted disclosure of her HIV status and stigma related to HIV. She also mentioned that she deletes the SMS text messages once she replies to them to avoid any possible disclosure of her status.
Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Discharge Condition:
The patient will be discharged once her treatment is completed.

Discharge Instructions:
The patient is instructed to continue with ART medication as per the instructions given by the healthcare provider. The patient is also advised to follow up with the healthcare provider as per the scheduled appointments and to disclose any concerns or issues related to her treatment. The patient is also requested to maintain the confidentiality of her HIV status and not to reveal it to anyone without proper authorization. 

Signatures:
The discharge summary was dictated by the healthcare provider and reviewed and approved by the medical transcriptionist.

Dictated by: Dr. Sample
Reviewed by: John Doe, MT

text:
The principal diagnosis would be **B24, Unspecified human immunodeficiency virus [HIV] disease**.

The admission was for HIV infection treated with antiretroviral therapy (ART), so HIV disease is the condition chiefly responsible for the admission. The summary doesn't specify HIV-related complications or symptomatic stages, so the unspecified code applies. Z21 (asymptomatic HIV) isn't appropriate because the patient was started on treatment.

The documented nonadherence to ART could be captured with secondary codes, such as a noncompliance code from Z91.1- and an underdosing code from T37.8- (underdosing of other systemic anti-infectives, 6th character 6). The depression mentioned in the narrative isn't recorded as a formal diagnosis, so it shouldn't be coded unless the physician documents it. Coders should confirm the final code set against the ICD-10-AM/ACHI edition in use.
